items.label: 💻 LARGE CAPACITY & LAPTOP COMPARTMENT ☛ Size of womens laptop bag
items.value: 16.1"*6.3"*12.2".The dedicated laptop compartment provides maximum protection for your device. 2 inner pockets,2 slip pockets, and 1 zipper pocket for small items such as a phone, wallet, makeup, passport, etc.

items: 😆 COMFORTABLE AND CONVENIENT CARRYING ☛ The tote bag is designed with your comfort in mind. Detachable & reinforced stitching shoulder strap for durability, you can carry it as a crossbody bag, freeing your hands. Plus, the leather handle can adjust the length to fit different heights.

👝 COMPLIMENTARY CLUTCH BAG ☛ The clutch purse is compact enough to fit in your hand or easily slip into a larger bag, yet spacious enough to hold all your essentials, such as your phone, keys, cards, and makeup.

👒 VERSATILE AND PRACTICAL ☛ Built-in key hooks are perfect for keys or other accessories. The back pocket provides convenient storage space for your phone, wallet, and other small items! A side pocket in the bag is used to hold a water bottle or umbrella. The metal bottom nail makes our work shoulder bag wear and stain-proof.

💝 USE IN MULTIPLE SCENARIOS ☛ Our laptop tote bag is versatile enough to be used for various occasions, whether you're heading to the office, attending meetings, or going on a business trip. Ideal as a laptop tote, teacher tote bag, work bag, travel bag, or office business briefcase. Perfect gift for family, friends, and yourself.

👜 STYLISH AND CHIC DESIGN ☛ Our laptop tote bag combines the timeless elegance of leather with the trendy appeal of canvas. The combination of these materials creates a visually striking. Compared to traditional leather laptop bags, canvas laptop tote displays a youthful, fashionable, and relaxed style.
